io.webagent4j.common

Packages that use io.webagent4j.common
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.
io.webagent4j.common
 
io.webagent4j.core
WebAgent4J's public facade: the entry point application code starts from.
io.webagent4j.crawler.api
Backend-neutral HTTP crawler contracts - depends only on webagent4j-common: no HTTP client, no HTML parser, no Playwright.
io.webagent4j.locator
 
io.webagent4j.wait
The one deterministic polling/deadline primitive shared by locator resolution, verification polling, and action stabilization - not three independent timers.
